name: @visuelconcept-winccoa/wui-gis
description: GIS — standalone WinCC OA WebUI page: map-based monitoring on MapLibre GL / OpenStreetMap (no licence cost). One GIS_Site datapoint per site, holding geo-located assets bound to datapoints, areas (districts / sectors / catchments) grouping them, live value overlays, alarm highlighting from the OA alert state and a configurable drill-down from map to area to asset to its process or 3D view.

datapoints.note: One datapoint per site (Struct with String elements name + json), auto-created through /api/para on first use. Assets bind freely to existing project datapoints — the page creates none of them. Falls back to two in-memory demo sites (water network, smart city district) when no GIS_Site datapoint exists.

notes: gisSim — optional network simulator (no REST route of its own); drives the GisSim_* datapoints the site and the gis-plants page read
